payload.title: File:Tylosaurus rex illustration.png
payload.description_html: Illustration I’ve made of Tylosaurus rex, the largest species of the mosasaur genus Tylosaurus, the fossils of which were once classified as large specimens of T.proriger, based off of the Tylosaurus skeletal by Scott Hartman.
